prompt: Create an original 150 second fingerstyle acoustic folk instrumental composition for nature documentary, landscape and gentle exploration. Mood: organic, open, fresh. Instruments: steel-string guitar, mandolin, light hand percussion. Style: alternating bass picking and a clear acoustic melody. Tempo approximately 88 BPM; D dorian. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Introduce a gently rising motif and a sense of open air. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A mellow and reflective acoustic folk piece featuring a fingerpicked acoustic guitar melody, supported by a gentle bassline and light, brushed drums. The arrangement is clean and spacious, creating a calming atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首柔和而富有沉思感的原声民谣作品，以指弹原声吉他旋律为主，辅以轻柔的贝斯线和轻刷的鼓点。编曲干净且富有空间感，营造出一种宁静的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
